mentions.name: domain-tracker
mentions.description: A Ruby on Rails web app that tracks domains, featuring uptime monitoring and SSL expiration tracking. Built as a learning project following the GoRails SaaS tutorial, with the author's own additions of uptime monitoring and SSL expiration tracking.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been learning Ruby on Rails and recently deployed domain-tracker to reinforce Rails principles that were fuzzy to me.

This was built following the GoRails SaaS tutorial but I have added uptime monitoring and ssl expiration tracking as well.
